scope: Proposition A.3 (Ordered orbit-pair sampling) of the manuscript “Invariant-projection counterexamples for every irrational rotation” (preprints/Invariant-projection-counterexamples-for-every-irrational-rotation-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 293 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 951244ce4ac9e346), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With probability one in the choice of θ, the following holds for every finite I ⊂ N. There are positive finite Borel measures ηI,l on X × X converging weakly to λI, each carried by ordered pairs of the form (x, y) = (x, σn θ x) with n in a finite set of positive integers. Both marginals of ηI,l have L2(µ) densities, and their L2 norms are bounded uniformly in l. The bound may depend on I and on the fixed realization of θ. Weak convergence here means convergence against every continuous function on the compact space X × X.
